_verificationNote.whyNotIndexed: The deduction sits at IRC 163(h)(4), added by P.L. 119-21 sec. 70203. The statute contains no inflation-adjustment clause, and Rev. Proc. 2025-32 has no section for it. $10,000 / $100,000 / $200,000 / $200-per-$1,000 are fixed for tax years 2025 through 2028.
_verificationNote.sunset: Applies only to taxable years beginning after 2024-12-31 and before 2029-01-01 (IRC 163(h)(4)(A)). This file must not be cloned forward past tax year 2028.
_verificationNote.roundingIsDeliberatelyDifferent: IRC 163(h)(4)(C)(ii)(I) says '$200 for each $1,000 (or portion thereof)' and Schedule 1-A line 28 says to INCREASE a partial step to the next HIGHER whole number. This is the opposite of the tips and overtime phase-outs, which round DOWN. fractionCountsAsFullStep=true is correct here and must not be 'harmonised' with the other two.
howToRecheckAnnually: 1. Schedule 1-A (Form 1040), Part IV — the authoritative computation: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1040s1a.pdf
2. Instructions for Schedule 1-A, Part IV, inside the Form 1040 instructions: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040gi.pdf
3. Statute as enacted, P.L. 119-21 sec. 70203, 139 Stat. 176-178: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/PLAW-119publ21/pdf/PLAW-119publ21.pdf
4. Proposed regulations 26 CFR 1.163-16 (cited throughout the Schedule 1-A instructions) — check for a final rule.
_verificationNote.eligibilityCriteriaNotModelled: Verified statutory criteria this file does NOT encode: gross vehicle weight rating under 14,000 lbs; vehicle class limited to car, minivan, van, SUV, pickup truck or motorcycle with at least 2 wheels; loan must be secured by a FIRST LIEN on the vehicle; lease financing, fleet-sale loans, salvage-title vehicles, scrap/parts vehicles, non-personal commercial vehicles and related-party loans are all excluded; refinancing qualifies only up to the outstanding balance of the refinanced loan and only if first-lien secured; the VIN of every applicable vehicle must be reported on the return. Negative equity rolled into the loan does not qualify.
_verificationNote.unlikeTheOtherThree: IRC 163(h)(4) imposes NO joint-filing requirement and NO SSN requirement, so the absence of requireJointIfMarried in this file is correct.
